Purpose and scope

This policy sets out how a resident's continence needs are assessed and supported at Alderbridge Care Group. It applies to every resident at every site.

Policy statement

A continence assessment must be completed within one week of admission and reviewed 6-monthly — no longer merely advisory — supporting a resident's dignity and comfort through an individualised, appropriate approach rather than a one-size-fits-all product or routine.

Roles and responsibilities
